userStories.title: Schema base: enums, User, Skill, Job

Create model User with fields: id (cuid), clerkId (unique), email (unique), name, phone?, zipCode?, linkedinUrl?, desiredRole?, cvUrl?, plan (default FREE), dailyQuota (default 1), emailDigest (default true), emailOnViewed (default true), emailOnFailed (default true), automationPaused (default false), excludeCompanies String[] (default []), minSalary?, createdAt, updatedAt; relations: skills[], applications[]
Create model Skill with fields: id (cuid), name, userId; relation to User (cascade delete); @@unique([name, userId]); @@index([userId])

Create model Job with fields: id (cuid), title, company, location?, salary?, description?, linkedinUrl (unique), requirements String[], remote (default false), applyType (default EASY_APPLY); relation: applications[]; @@index([linkedinUrl])
Run prisma migrate dev successfully

userStories.title: Worker scraper: coleta anônima de vagas via Playwright
userStories.description: As the system, I need the scraper worker to collect LinkedIn jobs using anonymous Playwright sessions with rotating proxies so user credentials are never stored.
acceptanceCriteria: BullMQ worker 'scraper' consumes jobs from queue 'scraper'
Each job execution creates a new Playwright browser context with randomized fingerprint: userAgent, viewport (1280–1920px random width), timezone (America/Sao_Paulo), locale (pt-BR)
Requests are routed through residential proxy (config via PROXY_URL env var in format http://user:pass@host:port)
Rate limit: max 2 requests per second per session (implemented via delay helper)
On captcha or IP block detection (HTTP 429, redirect to challenge page): exponential backoff 30s → 60s → 120s with proxy rotation between attempts
After 3 failed attempts: fallback to LinkedIn Jobs Guest API endpoint with desiredRole as query param
Collected jobs are upserted by linkedinUrl (dedup); applyType is set based on presence of Easy Apply button
Maximum jobs collected per run: User.dailyQuota × 3
Creates ApplicationLog entry with action SCRAPE for each collected job
Enqueues 'matching' job with { userId, jobIds[] } on completion
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created workers/scraper.ts: BullMQ Worker consuming 'scraper' queue. Playwright browser context with randomized userAgent/viewport/locale/timezone, optional PROXY_URL routing. Rate limit 500ms between requests (2 req/s max). Challenge detection (HTTP 429, /checkpoint, /authwall, /captcha) triggers exponential backoff (30s→60s→120s) + proxy rotation across 3 attempts. After 3 failures: fallback to LinkedIn Jobs Guest API HTML parser. Jobs upserted by linkedinUrl; applyType set by Easy Apply button presence. Application records created PENDING (upsert dedup). SCRAPE ApplicationLog per job. Enqueues 'matching' job with { userId, jobIds[] }. Exports scraperQueue + matchingQueue for cron (US-019). Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Worker matching: scoring e filtros excludentes
userStories.description: As the system, I need the matching worker to calculate compatibility scores, apply exclusion filters, and select the top N jobs for candidature.
acceptanceCriteria: BullMQ worker 'matching' consumes jobs from queue 'matching'
Discards jobs from companies in User.excludeCompanies[] (case-insensitive match)
Discards jobs where salary is present and below User.minSalary (when minSalary is set)
Calculates matchScore for each remaining job: (number of User skills found in Job.requirements) / Job.requirements.length × 100
Filters out jobs with matchScore < 40
Selects top N jobs by matchScore descending, where N = User.dailyQuota
Creates Application records with status PENDING for selected jobs (upsert, skip if already applied)
Creates ApplicationLog entry with action MATCH and detail { score, skillsMatched: string[], skillsMissed: string[] } for each evaluated job
Enqueues 'apply' job with { applicationIds[] } on completion
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created workers/matching.ts: BullMQ Worker consuming 'matching' queue. Loads user with skills. Filters out excluded companies (case-insensitive) and jobs below minSalary. Calculates matchScore = (skillsMatched / requirements.length) × 100 (100% when no requirements). Filters out matchScore < 40. Selects top N by score (N = dailyQuota). Upserts Application records with matchScore. Creates MATCH ApplicationLog with { score, skillsMatched, skillsMissed }. Exports applyQueue + enqueues 'apply' job with { applicationIds[] }. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Worker apply: Easy Apply (modal LinkedIn)
userStories.description: As the system, I need the apply worker to handle Easy Apply jobs by filling and submitting the LinkedIn quick-apply modal.
acceptanceCriteria: BullMQ worker 'apply' consumes jobs from queue 'apply'
For each applicationId with Job.applyType = EASY_APPLY: set status → APPLYING, create ApplicationLog { action: FILL_FORM }
Playwright navigates to Job.linkedinUrl, clicks the 'Candidatar-se fácil' button
Fills modal fields: name (User.name), email (User.email), phone (User.phone), uploads CV from User.cvUrl
Takes screenshot of filled form, uploads to Supabase Storage at screenshots/{applicationId}/final.png, creates ApplicationLog { action: SCREENSHOT, screenshotUrl }
Submits form
On success: set status = SENT, appliedAt = now(), create ApplicationLog { action: SUBMIT, detail: { result: 'success' } }
On CAPTCHA or timeout after 60s: set status = FAILED, failReason = CAPTCHA or TIMEOUT, create ApplicationLog { action: SUBMIT, detail: { reason } }
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Worker apply: formulários externos com heurísticas e fallback manual
userStories.description: As the system, I need the apply worker to handle external application forms using field heuristics, with a graceful fallback when the form cannot be mapped.
acceptanceCriteria: For each applicationId with Job.applyType = EXTERNAL: Playwright navigates to Job.linkedinUrl and follows the external redirect
Field detection heuristic: identify input fields by matching label text, name attr, id attr, and placeholder against known patterns (email, phone, name, resume/cv)
Calculate mapping ratio: mappedRequiredFields / totalRequiredFields

If mapping ratio < 0.70: set status = FAILED, failReason = FORM_NOT_SUPPORTED, directUrl = Job.linkedinUrl, create ApplicationLog { action: SUBMIT, detail: { reason: 'FORM_NOT_SUPPORTED', mappedFields: number, totalRequired: number } }
If mapping ratio >= 0.70: fill identified fields with User data, upload CV to file input if found, take screenshot, submit form
On successful submission: set status = SENT, appliedAt = now()
On CAPTCHA or timeout: set status = FAILED, failReason = CAPTCHA | TIMEOUT
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Cron diário: disparo do pipeline às 08h00 BRT
userStories.description: As the system, I need a daily cron to enqueue scraper jobs for all eligible users at 08:00 BRT.
acceptanceCriteria: BullMQ repeatable job configured with cron expression '0 11 * * *' (UTC = 08:00 BRT)
On each tick: queries all Users where cvUrl IS NOT NULL AND skills count >= 3 AND automationPaused = false
For each eligible user: checks if they already hit dailyQuota today (count of Applications with createdAt >= today 00:00 BRT); skips if quota reached
Enqueues one 'scraper' job per eligible user with { userId }
Logs structured output: { processed: N, skipped: N, reason: 'quota_reached' | 'paused' | 'incomplete_profile' }
Typecheck passes
